svg.title: How a watch escapement keeps time
svg.desc: A Swiss lever escapement running ten times slower than life. The balance wheel swings on its hairspring, its pin throws the pallet fork from one banking pin to the other, and each throw lets the escape wheel advance half a tooth before a ruby stone locks it again. A camera zooms in on the escape wheel, the pallet fork and the balance wheel in turn, each with its name and a leader line, and pulls back out.

g.text: 15 teeth · half a tooth a beat
